text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: nora (oncall) - service=runtime-serving severity=Pg1. Symptoms: >50% of runtime pods CrashLoopBackOff with SIGSEGV, node flaps observed. Please acknowledge.

nora: ack. Seeing segfaults in runtime process after autoscaler pushed new queuing config + quantization flag enabled in image: `runtime-engine:quant-8b-2026`.

nora: pod status quick:
```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods | grep runtime
runtime-5b4c2  CrashLoopBackOff  1/3  0  1m
runtime-5b4c2-1 CrashLoopBackOff  1/3  0  3m
runtime-5b4c2-2 Running         3/3  0  12m
```

jas: paste of container log tail (failing):
```
E 22:17:02 fused_quant.cc:221] buffer overrun detected: idx 15360 > max 15360
E 22:17:02 runtime_main.cc:512] uncaught exception: std::runtime_error: illegal memory access
#0 0x7f9b4c1a0f4 in fused_quant_attention(float*, ...) at fused_quant.cu:221
#1 0x7f9b4c0f2d8 in execute_step(runtime_ctx*) at runtime_main.cc:498

Fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7ffd1a2ff000 (code=1)
```

omar: I pulled dmesg on k8s-gpu-12 (where many crashed):
```
[ 2452.112345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 13, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 2452.112400] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel paging request at 00007f9b4c1a0f4
```

rachel: any recent infra changes? autoscaler bump + node-kernel updated to 5.15.0-58 during the maintenance window at 21:40. Could be driver/kernel mismatch with the quantized kernels.

nora: we're going to pause the rollout and rollback the runtime image to the last known-good tag `runtime-engine:stable-2026-0301`. Also cordon the noisy node k8s-gpu-12 and set node to unschedulable.

jas: rolling back image now.
```
$ kubectl -n inference set image deployment/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.io/runtime-engine:stable-2026-0301
deployment.apps/runtime image updated
$ kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/runtime
Waiting for rollout to finish: 3 old replicas are pending termination...
Rollout completed
```

jas: cordoning/evicting the node k8s-gpu-12.
```
$ kubectl cordon k8s-gpu-12
node/k8s-gpu-12 cordoned
$ kubectl drain k8s-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
node/k8s-gpu-12 drained
```

omar: after cordon+rollback, crashloop count dropped from 8->2 over 8 minutes. However, we still see one pod recreating and OOM-killing then segfaulting on resume. Looks like a residual kernel issue on one host.

nora: taking these actions now:
- Keep rollout pinned to stable-2026-0301 until eng-runtime ships patch.
- Scale down replicas on the affected nodeselector pool to reduce scheduling pressure.
- Disable autoscaler for runtime deployment temporarily.

jas: scaling down and suspending HPA.
```
$ kubectl -n inference scale deployment/runtime --replicas=4
deployment.apps/runtime scaled
$ kubectl -n inference patch hpa/runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4,"maxReplicas":4}}'
```

jas: HPA frozen at 4 replicas. Will re-enable once we validate.

rachel: customer-impact snapshot: hosted text-generation errors increased to 6% over baseline during the window; 3 customers hit higher tail-latency. No data loss reported. Support tickets opened: #SUP-4432 (fin-analytics), #SUP-4433 (ad-svc).

incident-bot: Incident created — IR-2026-021: runtime segfaults with quantized fused kernels. Owners: eng-runtime, infra-gpu. Severity Pg1. Channel: #incidents.

omar: I'm collecting a kdump from the affected host for kernel oops analysis; uploading to S3 when done. Also capturing nvcrash logs.

nora: eng-runtime, please prioritize a short-term mitigation: build a patched image that disables the fused quantized kernel path (fall back to non-fused) and run a canary on two nodes. If that stabilizes, we can promote. Also add guard checks for buffer bounds.

jas: building a canary image `runtime-engine:canary-disable-fused-2026-03-15` and will push canary to nodes k8s-gpu-21/22.
```
$ kubectl -n inference set image deployment/runtime-canary runtime=registry.redwood.io/runtime-engine:canary-disable-fused-2026-03-15
```

jas: canary deployed; monitoring logs now. No segfaults in the first 6 minutes.

omar: kernel team flagged that driver 460.x had regressions with memory eviction in combination with certain cudaMemcpy patterns used by fused kernels. Recommend testing on driver 470.x or reverting to 455.x for stability.

nora: action items (in-thread):
- infra-gpu: validate driver matrix and roll nodes to recommended driver (omark).
- eng-runtime: add bounds checks + non-fused fallback short-term, run SR runbook.
- devops: keep pinned image and HPA frozen until we confirm stability (jas).
- support: notify impacted customers with ETA for resolution (rachel).

jas: handing off oncall to omar in 25m for continued monitoring. If we need an incident bridge, I'll start it.

omar: will take over at ~1765502500. I'll keep the canary under watch and start driver roll for a small subset.

rachel: drafting comms now. Will include mitigation steps and expected timeline of 2-4 hours for full validation.

nora: good work team. I'll open the post-incident ticket and add timeline + logs. Please attach kdump and nvcrash artifacts when available.

incident-bot: Incident annotated with artifacts pending: s3://redwood-incidents/IR-2026-021/artifacts.

jas: update 20m later: canary stable for 20m, crashloops stopped cluster-wide after rollback and canary nodes show normal. Keeping nodes under observation.

omar: starting a small driver roll to 470.57 on two spare nodes to validate there are no regressions.

rachel: support notified customers with details and mitigation. One customer requested SLA credit; support has escalated to finance.

nora: final note: schedule an RCA with eng-runtime + infra next week; include test coverage for quantized/fused kernels under driver variations and add a guarded feature-flag for fused paths.

jas: thanks everyone. Leaving handoff to omar.
